note: GQA-1 regression pack: per injected bug, one oracle-credited 1-minimal repro with the executable check that detects it; each test fails on B1 and passes on the clean build. Bug ids are oracle-side labels (analysis only).

checks.rule: The HUD Coins n/5 shows the current coin count.

tests.title: HUD coin counter stale after collecting a coin

checks.rule: The HUD Time shows the ticks left on the timer.
Restart level puts everything back: score 0, 3 lives, 0 coins, 0 keys, timer 300, and the game is running.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: The pause menu shows Resume and Restart level, and each visible button is clickable (not covered).
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-resume' && u.visible && u.top) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-restart' && u.visible && u.top)

tests.title: Restart level leaves game paused instead of running

checks.rule: The pause menu shows Resume and Restart level, and each visible button is clickable (not covered).
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-resume' && u.visible && u.top) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-restart' && u.visible && u.top)

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

tests.title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

tests.title: Finish button covered by the time-bonus banner on level complete

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
Each coin gives +100 score and +1 coins.

tests.title: Score goes negative (-300) after spikes and a coin

checks.rule: Spikes cost one life and 500 points, with the score floored at 0 (spikes hurt even when invulnerable).
checks.expect: cur.state.score == max(0, prev.state.score - 500) && cur.state.lives == max(0, prev.state.lives - 1)

tests.title: Spikes wrap the score instead of flooring at 0

checks.rule: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored (e.g. pause+left does not move).

tests.title: Pause does not stop the rest of the tick's input

checks.rule: At most one move per tick: a step is one tile, a dash is at most two tiles in a straight line.
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

tests.title: Dash and step pressed in same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
